specs.title: P07: a serialized forecast that claims its own allowed uses is not summed
current-read nonce mismatch withholds projected points; the echoed nonce restores them
trusted Yahoo server confirmations set 100/0, unknown keeps its prior, and expiry withdraws points despite saved spoofed marks
